answer.text: Standard terms are 30 days from invoice date for all trade accounts, unless a signed contract says otherwise. An invoice 60+ days overdue means new orders need Finance approval. An account goes on stop if any invoice is 90+ days overdue or the balance exceeds the credit limit.
assumptions: 'On hold' is read as the policy section 'When an account is placed on hold', which covers both the approval requirement and the stop.

citations.section: When an account is placed on hold
